<?php

$webRoot = $_SERVER["DOCUMENT_ROOT"];
$baseDir =  dirname($webRoot);

/** @var  $config */
$config = array (
    'debug' => true,
    'baseDir' => $baseDir,
    'webRoot' => $webRoot,
    'db' => array (
        'driver' => 'mysql',
        'host' => 'db',
        'db' => 'db',
        'user' => 'db',
        'password' => 'db',
        'port' => '3306',
        'options' => [
            PDO::MYSQL_ATTR_INIT_COMMAND => 'SET NAMES utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci',
            PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_WARNING,
        ]
    ),
    'ldap' => [
        'host' => 'ldap',
        'port' => 10389,
        'serverType' => Dsl\App\Tools\LdapUtility::SERVERTYPE_OPENLDAP,

        'password' => 'professor',
        'baseDn' => 'dc=planetexpress,dc=com',
        'filter' => '(&(objectClass=inetOrgPerson)(description=Human))',
    ],
    'smarty' => array (
        'tempDir' => $baseDir . '/template/smarty',
        'cacheDir' => $baseDir . '/cache/smarty',
        'compileDir' => $baseDir . '/cache/compile',
        'configDir' => $baseDir . '/config/smarty'
    ),
    'url' => array(
        'login' => '/login',
        'logout' => '/logout',
        'afterLogout' => '/login',  /* Redirect-URL nach erfolgreichen logout */

    ),
    'sessionIdentifier' => 'fachplan'
);
